text: This might be a silly one. My granddaughter is 11 and staying with me, she's had a temperature today. I've been giving her calpol and she's been absolutely fine in between, playing cards with me, drinking her squash and chatting non stop. Her colour's normal, lips and skin all as they should be. The reason I'm messaging is I saw purple marks all down her legs when she got in the bath and my heart nearly stopped, but it turns out it's felt tip, she'd been drawing on herself with her cousin and it came straight off with the flannel. So I think it's alright? I just wanted someone to tell me I'm not missing anything with the temperature.
